import numpy as np,mujoco
from rcb_hb import Session
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data
  self.cr=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange.copy();self.qa=np.array([self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] if self.m.actuator_trntype[i]==0 else -1 for i in range(61)])
  self.da=np.array([self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] if self.m.actuator_trntype[i]==0 else -1 for i in range(61)])
  self.init=np.zeros(61); self.init[self.qa>=0]=self.d.qpos[self.qa[self.qa>=0]]
  self.init[:11]=[0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0]
 def action(self,ctrl):return np.clip(2*(ctrl-self.cr[:,0])/(self.cr[:,1]-self.cr[:,0])-1,-1,1)
 def balance(self,ctrl,p=(.1,1,0.3,0.0)):
  # Pitch/roll feedback; ankle target shifts apply stabilising moments through planted feet.
  mat=self.d.xmat[self.m.body('pelvis').id].reshape(3,3)
  pitch=np.arctan2(mat[0,2],mat[2,2]);roll=np.arctan2(-mat[1,2],mat[2,2])
  vx=self.d.qvel[0];vy=self.d.qvel[1]
  ctrl[[4,9]]+=p[0]+p[1]*pitch+p[2]*vx
  ctrl[[1,6]]+=-0.8*roll-0.3*vy
  ctrl[[2,7]]+=p[3]
  return ctrl
 def ik(self,side,pos,rot=None,reference=None):
  ids=list(range(11,16))+[21,22] if side=='left' else list(range(16,21))+[41,42]
  qids=self.qa[ids];dids=self.da[ids];body=self.m.body('lh_palm' if side=='left' else 'rh_palm').id
  dd=mujoco.MjData(self.m);dd.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  if reference is not None:dd.qpos[qids]=reference
  jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  for _ in range(25):
   mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,dd)
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,dd,jp,jr,body)
   err=np.asarray(pos)-dd.xpos[body]
   J=jp[:,dids]
   if rot is not None:
    R=dd.xmat[body].reshape(3,3);re=sum(np.cross(R[:,k],rot[:,k]) for k in range(3))*.5
    err=np.r_[err,re*.5];J=np.r_[J,jr[:,dids]*.5]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.001*np.eye(len(err)),err)
   dd.qpos[qids]=np.clip(dd.qpos[qids]+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),self.cr[ids,0],self.cr[ids,1])
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<.001:break
  return ids,dd.qpos[qids].copy()

  qgoal[self.qa[:21]]=target[:21]
  delta=np.zeros(m.nv);mujoco.mj_differentiatePos(m,delta,1,d.qpos,qgoal)
  des=100*delta[:N]-20*d.qvel[:N];des[:6]=120*delta[:6]-22*d.qvel[:6]

  self.dd.qpos[:]=d.qpos;mujoco.mj_integratePos(m,self.dd.qpos,d.qvel,1e-5);mujoco.mj_forward(m,self.dd)
  J=[];jd=[];fc=[]
  for i,site in enumerate(self.feet):
   jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSite(m,d,jp,jr,site);j=np.r_[jp[:,:N],jr[:,:N]]
   jp2=np.zeros((3,m.nv));jr2=jp2.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSite(m,self.dd,jp2,jr2,site)
   jd.append((np.r_[jp2[:,:N],jr2[:,:N]]-j)/1e-5@d.qvel[:N]);J.append(j)
   R=d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3);re=sum(np.cross(R[:,k],np.eye(3)[:,k]) for k in range(3))*.5
   fc.extend(np.r_[180*(self.fp[i]-d.site_xpos[site]),180*re]-26*j@d.qvel[:N])
  J=np.concatenate(J);fc=np.array(fc)-np.concatenate(jd)
  w=np.ones(N);w[:6]=5;w[22:46]=.1;w[51:75]=.1

  iw=1/w

  mujoco.mj_fullM(m,self.M,d.qM)

  fw=np.tile([1,1,1,.004,.004,.004],2)
